sources.title: CPVO — Rijk Zwaan woodland strawberry applications
sources.enumerated_scope: CPVO Gazette 3/2021, Table I.1, printed page 33. Both Fragaria vesca rows are linked to party 00088 in the directory on printed page 191.
sources.limitations: The rows record 2021 applications for woodland strawberry. They give no current protection status, commercial name, release or growing location.
